tlog.msg: Light: DUSK.
CHAPTER E.3 — SUNLAMP ACTUAL (NORMAL). Dug-in bunker reported on high ground, grid bearing ~3700 mils. The effect bands are tight — put it on the roof.
Par time for full stars: 5:00.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "ICEBOX" grid 235 563 (grid brg 5549) · AB1002 "BREWERY" grid 230 574 (grid brg 5727). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Dug-in bunker reported on high ground, grid bearing ~3700 mils. The effect bands are tight — put it on the roof.
SOUTH OF THE RADIO MAST, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.
SUNLAMP ACTUAL, THIS IS MUSTANG 12, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 2368753625, BUNKER COMPLEX, OVER
sunlamp actual, this is mustang 12, adjust fire, grid 2368753625, bunker complex, over
SHEAF: CONVERGED (inferred) — small hard target — every piece on the same point.
FUZE: DELAY (inferred) — hard/overhead-cover target — penetrate, then burst.
MUSTANG 12, SUNLAMP ACTUAL — I HAVE A SPOT REPORT FOR YOU, RELAYED FROM BATTALION S-TWO, WHO WERE VERY PLEASED WITH THEMSELVES. SALUTE FORMAT. STAND BY, OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: It is a SPACE CANNON, killer, and it still wants the six elements in three transmissions. Doctrine does not care where the tube is parked.
SIZE: ONE FORTIFIED POSITION, SQUAD SIZE. ACTIVITY: DUG IN AND OBSERVING. THEY ARE NOT GOING ANYWHERE. LOCATION: SOUTH OF THE RADIO MAST, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT, OVER.
MUSTANG 12, SUNLAMP ACTUAL, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 2368753625, BUNKER COMPLEX, OUT.
UNIT: ASSESSED AS THIRD BATTALION REMNANTS, UNCONFIRMED. TIME: 18 MINUTES OLD. EQUIPMENT: AUTOMATIC WEAPON IN A COVERED EMPLACEMENT, OVERHEAD PROTECTION. OVER.
MESSAGE TO OBSERVER: ONE APERTURE IN ADJUST, FULL ARRAY IN EFFECT, DIRECTED ENERGY, TARGET NUMBER ALPHA ALPHA 7003. THANK YOU FOR CHOOSING SUNLAMP, OVER.

GUNNY BOTTLECAP: It will ask for a ten-digit grid. It will settle for what you have. Send the call like it is any other gun, because to the book, it is.
That report has been passed through four radios and two liars. Verify it yourself.
Solid copy. Somewhere a dead artillery instructor just felt a warm, deeply confused sense of pride.
DISCHARGE, OVER.

Copy FIRE FOR EFFECT. Six guns, one grid, zero fucking sympathy.
